items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Joe played with me a couple of times with Sam Bang. We went on the road... Joe played a couple of jobs with us.

ctx.x: Who the old man? Young Joe. Young Joe. Oh. No, I never played with, yeah, I played with Joe, yeah, Joe played with me a couple of times with Sam Bang. We went on the road, Birmingham, different places, Mobile. Yeah, Joe played a couple of jobs with us.
So he worked with Sam Joe then?
Yeah, Joe worked many jobs there with Sam.
